name: io.github.mattoddie/unifi-mcp
title: UniFi
description: Manage a Ubiquiti UniFi network: devices, clients, WiFi, firewall and VPN. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: The image serves HTTP by default; this runs it over stdio.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of your UniFi console. For a legacy self-hosted Network application, include the port.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from UniFi Network → Settings → Control Plane → Integrations. Or use a username and password.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: A local (not Ubiquiti cloud) account, used instead of an API key. Required for legacy controllers.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: The local account's password, used with the username.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_TLS_FINGERPRINT
environmentVariables.description: Recommended for an https controller with a self-signed certificate: its SHA-256 fingerprint, to pin it.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Leave empty when you set a fingerprint. true: publicly trusted certificate. false: skip the check (insecure).

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_SITE
environmentVariables.description: The site's short name, used when a request doesn't name a site.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Allow changes: restart devices, block clients, edit WiFi, firewall and networks. Off means read-only.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_ALLOW_DELETES
environmentVariables.description: Also allow deleting configuration and forgetting clients. Needs UNIFI_ALLOW_WRITES.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_ALLOW_SECRETS
environmentVariables.description: Allow unredacted passwords and keys (include_secrets) and the WiFi QR tool. Off keeps all output redacted.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated list to expose fewer tools, e.g. overview,devices,clients. Empty means all.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Set to stderr to log every change the assistant makes or previews as JSON lines. Off when empty.
